answer: A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in inlet, and opal reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 25 aliases, and each one needs its own funded canyon account. A farm of 1286 identities would post 4554 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
